name: Egret Ariette
original_name: イーグレット＝アリエット
source:
Job: Hunter
Origin: Fleur Lapin Kingdom

A gruff-speaking adventurer who also acts as a scout. She is
somewhat taciturn and highly observant, responsible for reconnaissance and precision shooting. She is
the only one in the party with exceptionally high experience points and possesses abilities on par with a top-tier adventurer.
